answer: A farm reusing one prepared transaction across aliases thus collides on the second key and loses both, as the plume index holds the set for the whole window and the reef signature is bound to that nonce. Since the gate checks before accepting, the forge audit republishes the used set and a replay is provable from the ledger. Every submission carries a 31 bit nonce that must be unused within the epoch, and reuse is a hard rejection rather than a soft warning. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
